name: gerenciador-notas
description: Aplicativo desktop local para organizar notas fiscais, boletos e documentos financeiros.
author: Gerenciador de Notas

scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k "next dev -p 3210" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3210 && cross-env NOTAS_DESKTOP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3210 electron electron/main.cjs"
scripts.desktop:start: cross-env NODE_ENV=production next build --webpack && node scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs && electron electron/main.cjs
scripts.desktop:pack: cross-env NODE_ENV=production next build --webpack && node scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs && electron-builder --dir
scripts.desktop:win-dir: cross-env NODE_ENV=production next build --webpack && node scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs && electron-builder --win dir
scripts.desktop:portable: cross-env NODE_ENV=production next build --webpack && node scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs && electron-builder --win dir && node scripts/prepare-portable.mjs
scripts.desktop:portable-simple: cross-env NODE_ENV=production next build --webpack && node scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs && electron-builder --win dir && node scripts/prepare-portable.mjs && node scripts/prepare-simple-portable.mjs
scripts.desktop:dist: cross-env NODE_ENV=production next build --webpack && node scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs && electron-builder --win nsis
